summary: The repaired Playwright TypeScript tests compile and run correctly with proper use of async/await and Playwright APIs. Selectors use data-testid attributes which improves reliability. Assertions are strong and awaited. Test case IDs are preserved in test titles. Minor warnings on generic heading selectors and price regex but acceptable given context.

issues.description: Selectors for product name use generic heading tags (h2, h3, h4) which may be insufficiently specific.
issues.recommendation: Consider using more specific data-testid attributes or class names for product name elements to improve selector robustness.

issues.description: Price selector uses a regex text locator which may be fragile if price format changes.
issues.recommendation: Use a dedicated data-testid or class selector for price elements if possible.

recommendations: Add more specific data-testid attributes for product name and price elements to improve selector reliability.
Consider adding test setup or teardown hooks if test data or state management becomes necessary in future.
